michael: Quick catch: onboarding feedback — people keep asking what "Scope" means in Roles. They think model scope or dataset scope.
jenny: Oof. We should be explicit. Proposal: label = "Route scopes" + help text "Which routes this role can call". Small example under hover.
oscar: Also missing link between role eval and quota assignment in telemetry. When fallback happens we can't tell which role permitted it. That makes cost root-cause hard.
ui-bot: UX idea: show a tiny "why allowed" chip in the role flyout. 1 line reason + link to policy JSON. :sparkles:
michael: Backend plan: add optional trace to roles API, e.g. GET /admin/v1/roles?tenant=acme&include=trace returns compact trace per role. Keep default off. Example minimal response (pseudo):
```
{ "roles": [ { "id": "r_9", "name": "DevOps", "priority": 50, "scopes": ["route:/generate"], "trace": { "matched_scope": "route:/generate", "rule_id": "rl_81", "reason": "explicit allow" } } ] }
```
jenny: +1 to optional. Also add a batch endpoint for route -> role traces so Console can fetch traces for N routes in one call.
oscar: Telemetry event: name `rbac.role_eval.v1`. Fields: tenant, route, role_id, matched_scope, outcome (allow|deny|fallback), quota_bucket, sampling_rate. Default sampling = 0.5% (so we don't flood events).
audit-bot: note: emitting role_id in telemetry requires privacy review for customer-supplied role names. Consider hashing role_name or only sending role_id.
michael: Good catch. we'll send role_id + tenant-visible label but not full role JSON. Option: send role_hash if tenant opted in.
jenny: Rollout flags: console feature flag `rbac.trace_ui` and API flag `rbac.trace_api`. Canary plan: 5% for 72h -> 25% for 7d -> 100% GA. Telemetry sampling default 0.5%, admin override to 5% per-tenant for diagnostics.
oscar: Performance note: trace generation touches authz cache. Make trace lazy: compute only when include=trace or when request has header `X-RBAC-Debug: 1`. Avoid increasing LRU size.
michael: Console microcopy: under Roles table header: "Route scopes — which routes this role can access. Hover for examples." Also add tiny FAQ link to docs: /docs/console/rbac#route-scopes.
jenny: I'll draft the copy and a small AB test: control vs "Route scopes (which routes this role can access)". 100 users each in Maze test.
oscar: API example for telemetry (trimmed):
```
POST /telemetry/v1/events
{ "event": "rbac.role_eval.v1", "tenant": "acme", "route": "/generate", "role_id": "r_9", "matched_scope": "route:/generate", "outcome": "allow", "quota_bucket": "standard", "sampled": true }
```
ui-bot: Console feature: Route debug panel to show small timeline: requests -> matched role -> quota bucket. Use sparklines + last-24h counts. Keep cheap (pre-aggregated counters).
michael: Can we surface last matched_rule_id in UI? Useful for debugging. Limit to last 5 matches.
jenny: Yes, but behind flag and with sampling. Also add a "Copy trace" button that dumps the minimal trace for support.
audit-bot: Add telemetry tag `privacy:role_id_only` and retention TTL 30d for traces.
oscar: Naming nit: call API field `trace` not `eval_trace` to keep payload short. Up to team.
michael: Fine with `trace`. jenny update design doc and open PRs: API + Console + Telemetry. Link to design: https://redwood.internal/designs/rbac-trace-sampling
jenny: On it. PR for console copy + flag coming this afternoon. ETA EOD for initial draft.
deploy-bot: deploy 4791016820 by jenny - canary: 5% prod - succeeded
